title: Textured Gemglass
body:
Retextures the gemstone glass blocks from Pastel and Spectrum with unique tiling patterns based on their gemstone's themes. Full blocks, semi-permeables and panes are retextured. Gemstone lights are not affected
![The 5 types of gemstone glass showcased on tuff bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8388a352c612406da0e7ebbe396aa62372c478d.png)
![The 5 glass types on black concrete, surrounding their corresponding polished gemstone blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0607885556daad453d3c506c908793509f61801.png)
